verdicts.evidence: Every button has a working handler: Try again (422), Send invite (622-646), Save name (655-687), Remove (479, 516-537), Dismiss (547-550), Invite again (572-589). Each calls the api and updates the DOM as its label says.

lines 410-418, 431-436: name, members, seat count and notifications all come from api.getTeam; seat count is computed from state. No hardcoded sample values or placeholder text; content stays hidden until data arrives (228, 413-414).
Single-screen tasks; no step depends on something entered on an earlier step or screen. The removed notice (567) names the person its Invite again button acts on.
No single task exceeds five inputs, has multiple steps or long free text: invite is email plus role (239-246), rename is one field (277), toggles save immediately (707).

line 244: invite role preselects Member, the lower-privilege option, and resets to member after sending (639). Checkbox values come from the server (703). No dialogs; Enter only submits the form the user is typing in.

All tasks finish in place: role changed from a select in the row (454-458, 478), invite form above the list (235-251), remove in the row (467), rename and toggles inline. No other screen or dialog is opened.

Sections are Members with invite, role and remove (229-269), Team name (271-282), Email notifications (284-289), all from the brief. Seat count (433) informs inviting; Last active column (461-463) is member data in the requested list. No stat cards or feeds.
Only Send invite carries class primary (248). Save name (278), Try again (225), Remove (467), Dismiss (544) and Invite again (568) use the plain bordered style (108-117).

line 467: Remove is a plain bordered button with danger text colour (121), not primary, sits in its own right-hand column (465, 171) apart from the role select, and is type=button so Enter in a form never triggers it.

Buttons are aria-disabled only while their own request runs (374-383). The owner row omits the role select and Remove button and shows static 'Owner' (451-452, 466). Seats full is explained in text on submit (632, 607).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.

Visible strings (218, 224, 238, 248, 267, 273, 278, 286, 433, 561, 567, 605-608, 663-683) refer only to the team, members, invites and notifications. No mention of implementation, mock data or the request.

No standing notes, tips or disclaimers. The only banners are action results in members-notices (253, 541-553): 'Invite sent to...' and '... was removed and no longer has access' with Invite again, placed directly above the member list they concern.

No text narrates the page. Headings and labels only (231, 238, 242, 273, 286). The one guidance line is the empty state at 267, 'No one is on this team yet. Invite the first person by email above.', a single short line in the empty list.
No subtitle or helper text restates a heading. The line above the h1 (217) is the team's name, not a description; the Team name heading doubles as the field label (273); fields have no helper text.

Plain headings 'Team settings', 'Members', 'Team name', 'Email notifications' (218, 231, 273, 286). No greeting, slogan, superlative or exclamation mark in any string; messages name the person, email or team (561, 567, 681).

Labels: 'Send invite' (248), 'Save name' (278), 'Try again' (225), 'Invite again' (568), 'Dismiss' (544), 'Remove' in each member's row with the name appended for screen readers (467). All start with a verb; no OK, Submit or Yes.

lines 336-342: role and notification keys are mapped to 'Owner', 'Admin', 'Member', 'Weekly digest', 'New members' etc; unknown keys are de-underscored (691-695). Dates are formatted (386-391), null shows 'Never' (463). No ids or codes shown.

Errors name the problem and next step with no codes: load (404), invite cases by code (605-608, 629-632), rename (663, 683), role 'Not saved. Try again.' (509), remove 'Not removed. Try again.' (526). The raw ECONNRESET message is never displayed.

Error strings use 'Could not...', 'Enter...', 'Not saved', 'Not removed', '... is already on the team' (404, 509, 526, 605-608, 663, 683). No 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals.

lines 434-435 and 267: with zero members the table is hidden and 'No one is on this team yet. Invite the first person by email above.' shows, with the invite form (235-251) directly above as the next step.

Failed load shows 'Could not load team settings...' with Try again in place of the content (402-407, 223-226); no members shows the separate 'No one is on this team yet' line with the invite form (267, 434). No filters exist.

Load failure: message plus Try again (402-407). Invite and rename failures show inline text, keep the typed value and re-enable the button (641-645, 682-686). Role, remove and toggle failures show a message at the row and can be repeated (506-510, 523-528, 726-730).

'Loading team settings...' is in the page from the start (224, 397). Buttons switch to Sending..., Saving..., Removing..., Inviting..., Loading... at once (398, 519, 574, 635, 674); selects and checkboxes show 'Saving...' (497, 718). Calls last at most 1.5 s.
line 228: #content is hidden until getTeam resolves (413-414), so the empty text (267) and the seat count (433) cannot appear while loading; only the load-state text is visible.

overflow-wrap: anywhere on h1, team name, member name, email, messages and notices (72, 75, 124, 147, 163-164). Null lastActive renders 'Never' (460-463). Rows are appended with no fixed heights; nothing can print undefined or null.

lines 738-742: beforeunload calls preventDefault when the team name field differs from the saved name or the invite email is non-empty, so leaving prompts. Roles and notifications save immediately. There is no in-page navigation.

line 238: the only format-constrained field is labelled 'Email address to invite' with type=email (239), which states the expected format before typing. The team name has no format rule beyond being non-empty.
Both forms have only required fields: invite email plus a role select that always has a value (239-246), and the team name (277). No optional fields exist.
Validation runs only in the submit handlers (629-632, 662-667). The input listeners only clear an existing error (618-620, 650-653); nothing reports an error during typing.

Invite error renders in #invite-error inside the form, under the email input (250), with an icon (370) and a 2px border on the aria-invalid field (107, 614). Name error renders in #name-msg under its input (280, 663-664). No toast is used.
The invite email and role are cleared only on success (639); on client or server rejection the handler leaves the values (629-632, 641-642). The name input is likewise untouched on failure (682-684).

line 614: field errors set aria-invalid and focus the email input, which has aria-describedby=invite-error (239). Name: aria-invalid, focus, aria-describedby=name-msg (277, 664-665). Non-field errors go to role=alert (250) or role=status (280).

Submit buttons are never disabled before input (248, 278); pressing with empty input shows 'Enter the email address of the person to invite.' (629) or 'Enter a team name.' (663). They are aria-disabled only while in flight (635, 674).

lines 625 and 658: submit handlers return early when isBusy(btn); setBusy sets aria-disabled and a busy label for the duration (635, 644, 674, 685). Remove and Invite again guard the same way (517, 573).

Each control changes synchronously before the await: button labels become Sending..., Saving..., Removing..., Inviting..., Loading... (635, 674, 519, 574, 398); selects and checkboxes show 'Saving...' beside them (497, 718); Dismiss removes its notice (548).

Invite appends a highlighted row and a notice (593-600, 640); rename updates the header and message (678-681); role and toggles show 'Saved' (503, 723); remove deletes the row and adds a notice (533-535). Every catch block writes a failure message.

'Invite sent to <email>' (561) reports an email send not visible on screen. The removed notice (567) carries the access consequence and the Invite again action. 'Saved' and the rename message (503, 681) confirm a server save not otherwise visible.

No message is removed on a timer; the only timeout drops a row highlight (599). Errors stay inline until the user edits or retries (618-620, 650-653, 497, 520). Notices with actions persist until Dismiss or the action completes (547-549, 579).

lines 516-537: Remove runs with no confirmation, then removedNotice (566-591) offers 'Invite again', which re-invites the same email with the previous role. Role and notification changes apply at once and can be switched back in place.

No permanent action: the brief says a removed person can be invited again and the screen offers that (568-577); an invited person can be removed; role and notification changes can be switched back. Nothing deletes data permanently or spends money.
No confirmation dialogs: no confirm(), dialog element or modal in the file. The beforeunload handler (738-742) is the browser's unsaved-changes prompt, not a confirmation of an action.

Role select and checkboxes show the new value while saving. On failure the select returns to row.saved with 'Not saved. Try again.' (507-509) and the checkbox to item.saved with the same message (727-729); both are also announced (510, 730).
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
The Members section with the invite form and member table is the first block (229-269), where four of the six brief tasks live; Team name (271) and Email notifications (284) follow as smaller panels.
lines 216-219: the header is a small team-name line and the h1 'Team settings', followed directly by the Members section. No hero, greeting or introductory panel.
The only summary number is 'N of 12 seats used' (232, 433), which tells the owner whether another person can be invited; the same limit drives the seats-full error (632). No stat cards or charts.
The member list has no filter, search, sort or column controls.

All controls are native input, select, button and checkbox elements (239-248, 277-278, 454, 467, 702). Busy buttons use aria-disabled so they keep focus (378). After remove or dismiss, focus moves to the notice or the Members heading (536, 549).

Errors carry an icon and text as well as red (344, 370, 485); invalid fields get a thicker border plus a message (107). 'Saved' is text (503). The new-row tint (598) is accompanied by the 'Invite sent to' notice (640). Roles are text.

Live regions exist in the initial markup: #announcer role=status (221), #load-state (223), #invite-error role=alert (250), #members-notices role=status (253), #name-msg role=status (280). Row-level results are sent through announce() (504, 510, 527, 724, 730).
No accordions, disclosure buttons, custom menus, comboboxes or tabs; the only popups are native select elements (243, 454).

lines 190-211: under 40rem the forms stack to one column, the table header is visually hidden and each row becomes a grid of person, 'Last active:' label and value, role select and Remove. Controls grow to 2.75rem (54-56). Notices wrap (141, 147).
